name: Forsaking God
overview: Scripture reveals that forsaking God involves turning away from His commandments and covenant, as the children of Israel did by fearing other gods and adopting the idolatrous practices of the heathen nations around them. They secretly committed sins against the LORD, building high places and setting up images and groves, thereby provoking His anger through disobedience and idolatry. This abandonment of God not only breaks His covenant but also brings about His wrath, demonstrating the serious consequences of forsaking the living God for false gods.
